accepted.reason: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. Reached only through @prisma/config, which the Prisma CLI uses to merge the operator's own configuration at `prisma migrate deploy` / `prisma generate` time. No request, tenant or user input reaches it; the API runtime uses @prisma/client, which does not depend on it. The fix needs deepmerge-ts 8, which arrives with the Prisma 7 major upgrade.
